name: release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]
    branches: [main]
  # required to trigger releases when the release PR is merged, or to rerun a release if needed
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  # Parse commits since the last tag, push a `release/vX.Y.Z` branch, open
  # or update a draft release PR, and close any superseded release PRs
  # (e.g. `release/v1.0.1` when the bump is now `release/v1.1.0`).
  pr:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write # push the `release/vX.Y.Z` branch and delete superseded ones
      pull-requests: write # create a release PR, update its body, close superseded PRs
    steps:
      - uses: danielroe/uppt/pr@7bcfb5397c37202ef882363f755423130419d28a # v0.5.5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  # The release PR was merged: tag the squash commit, cut a GitHub release
  # from the PR body, and dispatch the publish workflow. The `release/v`
  # head-ref guard keeps regular feature-PR merges from triggering this;
  # the head-repo guard keeps merged fork PRs from triggering it.
  release:
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      && github.event.pull_request.merged == true
      && startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/v')
      && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: release-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write # push the `vX.Y.Z` tag and create the GitHub release
      actions: write # `gh workflow run release.yml --ref vX.Y.Z` chained dispatch
    steps:
      - uses: danielroe/uppt/release@7bcfb5397c37202ef882363f755423130419d28a # v0.5.5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  # The chained dispatch from `release` lands here as a `workflow_dispatch`
  # event on a `vX.Y.Z` tag ref. The `pack` job installs deps, runs
  # `pnpm pack`, and uploads the tarball as a workflow artifact.
  # Manual recovery uses the same path (Run workflow -> pick a `v*` tag).
  pack:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: pack-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions: {}
    outputs:
      files: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.files }}
    steps:
      - id: pack
        uses: danielroe/uppt/pack@7bcfb5397c37202ef882363f755423130419d28a # v0.5.5

  # `publish` downloads the prebuilt tarball from the pack job's
  # artifact and stages it for publish.
  publish:
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
      && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
      && needs.pack.outputs.files != '[]'
    needs: pack
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: publish-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      id-token: write # OIDC claim for npm trusted publisher
    environment: npm # must match the trusted-publisher entry on npmjs.com
    steps:
      - uses: danielroe/uppt/publish@7bcfb5397c37202ef882363f755423130419d28a # v0.5.5
        with:
          files: ${{ needs.pack.outputs.files }}

Workspace: root module package `@lutejka/nuxt-otel` (src/), plus `playground`, `client` (devtools UI), `docs` (Docus site).

Client (`client/app`) is the devtools UI, built via `nuxi generate client` → `dist/client`, served as iframe by module's `devtools.ts`; published package resolves `./client` from dist. Dev uses proxy to the client dev server when dist/client is absent.

`client/app` components/utils/composables are reused by `docs` via filesystem aliases (`~~`→clientRoot, `~`→clientApp) and components/imports dirs — docs compiles client source directly.

Types duplicated: `client/types.ts` defines `Span`/`Trace`/`Log` (client+docs) and `src/runtime/otel/parse/parser.ts` defines identical types for the module.

Build/deploy flow:
- `prepack`: `nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxt-module-build build && pnpm client:build`.
- Release workflow (uppt): auto-bumps/creates release PR on every push to main — no path filter.
- Docs workflow: on push to main touching `docs/**`, `client/**`, or workflow; runs `pnpm dev:prepare` (module build + client prepare) then `docs:generate`.

docs/package.json does not depend on the published module (deps: `@opentelemetry/api`, `@vueuse`, `better-sqlite3`, `docus`, `nuxt`); it imports `~~/types` and client components. Docs build therefore does not need the module built or client prepared — the coupling comes only from the composed `dev:prepare` script (inertia, not a hard dependency).

Pain points:
- Building docs forces preparing module + client + docs together, due to the single `dev:prepare` script.
- Docs-only pushes to main trigger the release workflow (no path filter), producing unwanted release PRs — "need to release a new version to deploy docs".

Recommended changes:
1. Decouple builds: give each of module root, client, and docs its own build/prepare script and CI job. Docs deploy then needs only `pnpm install` (workspace symlinks provide client's deps) + `docs:generate`; no module build.
2. Release workflow: add `paths-ignore: ['docs/**']` to the push trigger. Do NOT ignore `client/**` — the client build is packaged into the published module, so client changes must still release. Mixed code+docs pushes still release.
3. Extract a shared package (e.g. `@nuxt-otel/shared`) for `Span`/`Trace`/`Log` and parser types plus trace/log utils (and shared store if desired). Single source consumed by module runtime, client UI, docs, and MCP; workspace dep for development, bundled into the published module. Removes duplication, but does not itself fix the build coupling — that is solved by the script/CI split.
